openings.claim: Unreliable storage addresses plausibly contribute to delayed pickups, but their contribution and affordable upkeep are unproven. Evaluate a bounded diagnostic probe before choosing an intervention.
openings.delta: Link encounter time to address accuracy instead of inferring causation from separate timing, shelf and exception samples; retain cart storage as an unresolved option.
openings.prediction: Second-location delays disproportionately coincide with stale exception entries or household-name mismatches, including outside the demand burst.
openings.rival_prediction: Demand concentration principally causes delays, while cart pickups are selectively easy; accurately addressed pickups still exceed two minutes mainly during the concentrated interval.
openings.defeat: A linked sample showing accurate exception locations and correct surname placement in most second-location delays, with delays instead tracking congestion, would defeat prioritizing address repair.
openings.probe: During routine pickups, the existing clerk adds brief address-error and peak-interval marks to the existing behind-desk timing sheet. Keep names and contact details behind the desk, retain the two shelves and cart, and keep all daily preparation, including probe preparation and correction work, within ten clerk-minutes. Stop additional recording at that budget; insufficient coverage yields no conclusion. Maintain identity checks and record wrong-reader handoffs. Compare delay patterns without claiming tested improvement.
assumptions: Enough linked observations can be captured within the preparation cap without materially slowing handoffs.
The clerk can distinguish address failures from congestion during ordinary retrieval.

decision: Converge on this constrained diagnostic next step, not an established cause or effective intervention. Its design preserves constraints; meeting 95% within two minutes with no wrong-reader handoffs remains unproven. Availability certainty may help readers but cannot replace correct, private, prompt pickup.

unresolved.issue: Address errors have not been linked to the delayed encounters; upkeep cost remains unknown.
Cart comparability and interview representativeness remain unsettled; all observations are synthetic stipulations.
